subject.why: Clearly depicts the thatched cottage with all requested key elements present.

category.why: Stands firmly on a wide ground plane with an appropriate simple sky backdrop.

clean.why: Free of text, interfaces, watermarks, and characters.

framing.why: The cottage is oversized and crowds the top and side borders.

colour.why: Warm, bright, and vibrant palette with clear separation from the sky.

detail.why: Maintains chunky, simplified shapes without excessive micro-textures.

style.why: Matches the smooth, satin 3D render look of the reference cards.

fix: Scale down the cottage slightly to ensure comfortable margins on the top and sides.
